name: deepmarks-extension
description: Save bookmarks to deepmarks.org and Nostr relays.

scripts.icons: mkdir -p public/icons && for s in 16 32 48 128; do sips -s format png -z $s $s public/pennant.svg --out public/icons/pennant-$s.png >/dev/null; done
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && mkdir -p chrome/code && rsync -a --delete dist/ chrome/code/ && cd chrome/code && zip -r -FS ../deepmarks-chrome.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && mkdir -p firefox/code && rsync -a --delete dist/ firefox/code/ && cd firefox/code && zip -r -FS ../deepmarks-firefox.zip .
scripts.package:safari-app: npm run build:safari-app && rsync -a --delete dist/ "safari/Deepmarks/Shared (Extension)/Resources/" && echo "Resources/ updated — open safari/Deepmarks/Deepmarks.xcodeproj to build"
scripts.publish:both: npm run publish:chrome && npm run publish:firefox
